items.title: Democrats Eye New Wealth Taxes, Even as California Ballot Initiative Falters
items.summary: Although a controversial proposed tax on billionaires appears headed for defeat in California, the idea of taxing great concentrations of personal wealth remains alive and well among Democrats following their resounding victory in nationwide voting this week. California’s Proposition 40 would impose a 5% tax on the wealth of billionaires who resided in the state at the beginning of 2026, with the revenues to be used for healthcare programs, food assistance and education.
